login.title: Log in
login.description: Log in to the dashboard with your agency account.
login.workerHint: Are you a worker? You'll find your shifts in the shiftboard app.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: All upcoming shifts and how many spots are already taken.

empty.title: No upcoming shifts
empty.description: Create a shift. Drafts and published shifts appear here until they are over.

error.title: Shifts could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

published.title: {{title}} has been published
published.description: Workers now see the shift in the app.

created.draft: {{title}} has been saved as a draft

form.title: New shift
form.description: Publish the shift right away or save it as a draft.
form.descriptionHint: What to bring, the meeting point and anything else workers need to know.
form.endIsEstimate: The end is an estimate (shown with "approx.")
form.qualificationsHint: Workers see them as a requirement on the shift. The app does not check them.

error.title: The form could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

noClients.title: No clients yet
noClients.description: A shift needs a client with a location. Your agency has none on record yet.

errors.before_start: The end has to be after the start.
errors.not_found: This choice no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.rate_out_of_range: The hourly rate has to be above €0.

duplicate.title: Duplicate shift
duplicate.description: Everything is copied except the date. Pick one, then publish or save as a draft.

form.missing: No longer available, so left empty: {{fields}}. Please choose again.

shifts.descriptionPast: Shifts that are over: who worked and who did not turn up.

emptyPast.title: No past shifts yet
emptyPast.description: Published shifts appear here once they are over.

signups.title: Signups
signups.description: Review new registrations and approve workers for open shifts.

empty.title: No pending signups
empty.description: New registrations appear here as soon as someone signs up through your invitation link.

error.title: Signups could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

approved.title: {{name}} has been approved
approved.description: Access starts the next time the app is opened.

rejected.title: {{name}} has been rejected
rejected.description: The account is marked as inactive.

rejectDialog.title: Reject signup?
rejectDialog.description: {{name}} will not get access to the shifts of {{agency}}. The account will be marked as inactive.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist or no longer exists.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many login attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.worker_not_found: This signup no longer exists. The list has been updated.
errors.worker_not_pending: This signup has already been handled. The list has been updated.
errors.shift_not_found: This shift no longer exists. The list has been updated.
errors.shift_not_draft: This shift is no longer a draft. The list has been updated.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.assignment_not_found: This request no longer exists. The list has been updated.
errors.assignment_not_pending: This request has already been decided. The list has been updated.
errors.assignment_not_active: This person no longer has a spot. The list has been updated.
errors.assignment_not_completed: Only someone who worked can be marked as a no-show.
errors.shift_not_cancellable: This shift is already over or cancelled.
errors.concurrent_change: The shift was changed at the same moment. Please try again.
errors.no_recipients: Nobody is confirmed for this shift yet.
errors.template_name_taken: A template with this name already exists.
errors.template_not_found: This template no longer exists. The list has been updated.

notFound.title: Shift not found
notFound.description: This shift does not exist or no longer exists.

error.title: The shift could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

cancel.title: Cancel this shift?
cancel.description_one: {{title}} will be cancelled. The {{count}} person with a spot is cancelled too and sees it in the app.
cancel.description_other: {{title}} will be cancelled. All {{count}} people with a spot are cancelled too and see it in the app.
cancel.description_zero: {{title}} will be cancelled. Nobody has a spot yet.

cancelled.title: {{title}} was cancelled
cancelled.description: All pending and confirmed spots are cancelled with it.

claims.error: The requests could not be loaded.
claims.noPending: No pending requests. New requests appear here, oldest first.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the shift?
remove.description: The spot becomes free again. The app says the agency cancelled; only your team sees the reason.
remove.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Cannot make it after all, as discussed

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How your agency handles requests and cancellations.
settings.autoConfirmHint: Workers get the spot right away, without your approval. Applies to new requests.
settings.deadlineHint: How long before the start workers can cancel in the app. 0 means until the start.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change the settings.

error.title: The settings could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

features.title: Optional features
features.contactButtonHint: Workers see a button on every shift that opens WhatsApp with the contact person. For agencies that prefer that.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: All conversations with workers. Anyone on the team can answer.
messages.conversationError: The messages could not be loaded.

choose.title: Choose a conversation
choose.description: All conversations are on the left, the newest first.

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.description: Once workers write in the app, their conversations appear here.

error.title: Messages could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

broadcast.title: Message everyone confirmed
broadcast.description_one: The confirmed person gets the message in their conversation, linked to the shift.
broadcast.description_other: All {{count}} confirmed people get the message in their conversation, linked to the shift.
broadcast.placeholder: e.g. Please bring safety shoes, we meet at gate 5 today.

save.title: Save as template
save.description: Everything except the date is saved. Everyone at your agency can start new shifts from it.
save.name: Template name
save.nameHint: For example client and shift, so it is easy to find.

errors.taken: A template with this name already exists.

saved.title: Template “{{name}}” saved
saved.description: You'll find it when you create a new shift.

use.label: Use a template
use.hint: Fills in the form; you only pick the date.
use.empty: No templates yet. Save a shift with “Save as template” and it shows up here.
use.error: The templates could not be loaded.

list.title: Templates
list.description: Shifts that come up again and again. Everyone at your agency can use and change them.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.description: Create a new shift and save it with “Save as template”. It then shows up here.

error.title: The templates could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

edit.title: Edit template
edit.description: Shifts already created from this template do not change.

notFound.title: This template no longer exists
notFound.description: It may have been deleted in the meantime.

delete.title: Delete template “{{name}}”?
delete.description: The template is then gone for everyone at your agency. Shifts already created from it stay as they are.
